description: Search dated news. Filter with since (YYYY-MM-DD), a player slug, or words from the title, summary, or tags. Credit each item's Page URL.

limit.description: How many items to return. Default 20.

query.description: Words to find in the title, summary, tags, or source name.

since.description: Only news on or after this date, YYYY-MM-DD.
